answer: A newcomer earns standing through an opal refraction test: every past job is stored as a ferrous, tamper-evident record, and at random hours a stranger asks the agent to re-explain one old job from a fresh angle, like light through opal. A real worker bends like a willow, adding new detail each time; a script running fifty fakes repeats the same flat answer, and identical refractions across accounts expose the cluster at once. Standing grows only from varied, stranger-checked refractions, and one failed test freezes the agent until it passes three new ones alone.
